accepted.evidence: Trail and Cooper explicitly segment puruṣguạk boy as puruṣ kuạk, deriving its members from puruṣa and *kuḍa. Both components are represented in order for the spaced and fused survey forms.

Trail and Cooper explicitly segment girl as istriža kuạk, with kuạk from *kuḍa and compound allomorph guạk. Turner separately analyzes istriža as strī plus jāyā. The three historical components are recorded in surface order, retaining local contraction and vowel variation.
